title: Phase 6: Create deployment automation scripts
acceptance_criteria: Database migration script with rollback capability
code_example:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# scripts/deploy.sh

set -e

echo "🚀 Starting CTMS deployment..."

# Configuration
BACKUP_DIR="/var/backups/ctms/$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
DEPLOY_DIR="/var/www/ctms"

# Create backup
echo "📦 Creating backup..."
mkdir -p $BACKUP_DIR
cp -r $DEPLOY_DIR/* $BACKUP_DIR/ 2>/dev/null || true
mysqldump -u root ctms > $BACKUP_DIR/database.sql 2>/dev/null || true

# Git pull
echo "📥 Pulling latest code..."
cd $DEPLOY_DIR
git pull origin main

# Install dependencies
echo "📦 Installing dependencies..."
cd backend
composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader
cd ../frontend
npm ci

# Build frontend
echo "🔨 Building frontend..."
npm run build

# Run migrations
echo "🗄️ Running database migrations..."
cd ../backend
php artisan migrate --force

# Clear caches
echo "🧹 Clearing caches..."
php artisan cache:clear
php artisan config:clear
php artisan view:clear

# Reload PM2
echo "🔄 Reloading PM2 processes..."
cd ..
pm2 reload ecosystem.config.js --env production

# Health check
echo "🏥 Running health checks..."
sleep 5
./scripts/health-check.sh

echo "✅ Deployment complete!"
```
